_note: From the machine transcripts in the NightFever season folders (27 Nov 2026). 'transcript' = the words exactly as transcribed; 'quote' = the same words with names spelled right (the speech-to-text writes Haoui as 'Howie', Montaug as 'Montauk'/'Montaugh', Danceteria as 'Dan Sateria', Xtravaganza as 'Extravaganza'). Times are where the first line starts. S03E01 has only a Teams transcript: 'Talare 1' = James St. James, 'Talare 2' = Patricia Field, 'Talare 3' = Fenton/Randy.

angie-xtravaganza.speaker: Patricia Field
angie-xtravaganza.context: Pat judging at a ball: she 'copped' Mother Angie for the run in her black stocking
angie-xtravaganza.quote: I think I got into a fight with, well, there were a few different episodes at that ball. One was Angie Xtravaganza with the hose with the big run in it, the black hose with the big run in it.
angie-xtravaganza.transcript: I think I got into a fight with, well, there were a few different episodes at that ball. One was Angie Extravaganza with the / Hose with the big run in it, the black hose with the big run in it.

exchange.speaker: James St. James
exchange.text: Okay, well, first of all, so Mother Angie Extravaganza is the mother of the House of Extravaganza.

exchange.speaker: James St. James
exchange.text: But she walked on stage with runs in her hose, and you were judging.

exchange.speaker: Patricia Field
exchange.text: Walked down the runway with a big run on her black stocking, and I was like...

exchange.speaker: James St. James
exchange.text: So you copped Mother Angie Extravaganza?

angie-xtravaganza.check: The brief said 'dressing Angie for the balls' - it's not that: Pat was JUDGING the ball and marked Angie down ('copped' her) for the laddered stocking.

angie-xtravaganza.speaker: James St. James
angie-xtravaganza.context: James to Christina Visca about the Sound Factory regulars of the Paris Is Burning years
angie-xtravaganza.quote: So many of the people who went to Sound Factory have gone on to become just legendary legends in gay culture and everything. This is around the time of Paris Is Burning in the 80s. You had like Mother Angie Xtravaganza who I would see there every week and Willie Ninja and Venus Xtravaganza.

angie-xtravaganza.check: Christina's answer (00:27:35) is about the Xtravaganzas as family ('we would all get together outside the club when the club closed... we would go up to the park, Junior would bring his boom box') but doesn't name Angie - usable as a second box only if you want her side.

haoui-montaug.speaker: James St. James / Lincoln Palsgrove IV

I had Sally Randall as / [0:02:41] James: number one. Oh, really? She was my number two.
haoui-montaug.check: Short and a dialogue (the speaker turns are a bit blurred in the machine transcript: 'I had Sally Randall as number one' is Lincoln's, then James: 'Oh, really? She was my number two'). Worth a listen at 00:02:20 before use. Second Haoui moment in the same episode: 00:15:20 James 'Howie helped ease getting into the clubs as well for you, like Palladium' - Lincoln: 'For sure, for sure. I think once Howie recognized that I was friends with Jennifer, that made it a shoo-in.'
